summary: MDxHealth SA furnished a Form -6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on October 16, 2026, attaching a press release dated October 15, 2026, that disclosed preliminary unaudited third-quarter 2026 revenue from continuing operations of approximately $22.7 million, flat with the prior-year period, and suspended full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $110-115 million. Tissue-based test volume fell 11% to 11,232 while liquid-based volume rose to 11,792. Cash was about $31.7 million at September 30, 2026. Management cited sales-force turnover following the Resolve mdx discontinuation; no special-situation transaction terms apply.
